# Q3 Planning Meeting Summary — 2026-08-27

## Key points

- Reconciliation revamp approved as the Q3 anchor initiative; build over buy after evaluating Recur ($180K/yr) and LedgerFlow ($140K, no jurisdiction-specific tax code support).
- Reconciliation rewrite scoped at ~6 engineer-weeks, including FX rounding module migration, driven by multi-currency batch failures (3 incidents this quarter, support tickets up 40% QoQ).
- Karim from platform needed for 2 weeks to support ledger integration on the reconciliation rewrite.
- Mobile receipt-capture v1 will ship without bulk-select; bulk-select added to roadmap as a fast-follow.
- OCR confidence indicator to be made more prominent based on user testing feedback (6 users).
- Vendor payout SLA target set at 48h p95 from invoice approval (current p95 is 71h), aiming for mid-Q3 delivery.
- Path to 48h SLA requires eng to cut ACH batching window from 12h to 4h (~half a sprint plus SRE sign-off) and ops to add a second approver on the west-coast shift.
- ACH batching change is conditional on SRE confirming monitoring load is manageable; otherwise intermediate SLA targets will be considered.
- Audit-log retention update officially pushed to Q4, confirmed with Legal.
- Internal admin-tool refresh remains with the intern crew — no changes.
- On-call rotation proposal requested in response to bug-bash burnout flagged by HR.
- Q3 scope must be locked by Friday; Sara presents at exec review Monday.

## Action items

- Marcus: Sync with Karim's manager and confirm Karim's 2-week availability, by end of this week.
- Marcus: Complete ACH batching-window trade-off analysis (including SRE sign-off review), by next week's meeting.
- Marcus: Propose a rotating on-call structure, by August 31st.
- Dan: Update mobile receipt-capture specs (v1 without bulk-select, more prominent OCR confidence indicator), by Wednesday.
- Jenna: Pair with Marcus on the ACH trade-off analysis, by next week's meeting.
- Priya: Circulate the Q3 scope draft for review, by Thursday morning (ahead of Friday lock).
- Priya: Add bulk-select receipt upload to the roadmap as a fast-follow, this week.
- Sara: Present Q3 scope at exec review, Monday.
